# Shimmer Labs

> Custom software development agency in Stillwater, Oklahoma specializing in web apps, iOS apps, API integrations, and AI agents.

Shimmer Labs builds custom software for small businesses. Founded by Logan Shimmer, a mechanical engineer turned software developer. We take ideas from wireframe to production — mobile apps, web apps, Shopify development, and API integrations. Based at 901 S. Main St, Stillwater, OK 74074.

## Services
- [API Integrations](https://shimmerlabs.co/services/api-integrations): Custom API integrations and backend development ($3,500–$12,000)
- [Wireframe to Web App](https://shimmerlabs.co/services/idea-to-web-app): Figma/Subframe to production Next.js app ($18,500–$55,000)
- [iOS App Development](https://shimmerlabs.co/services/ios-apps): Native iOS development in Swift ($35,000–$75,000)
- Full-Stack SaaS Development: 0-to-1 SaaS product development ($45,000–$125,000)
- AI Agent Development: Custom AI agents for business automation

## Products
- [Paidly](https://paidly.co): AI-powered invoicing with contract intelligence for freelancers
- [EventSnag](https://eventsnag.app): iOS app that turns event screenshots into calendar entries
- [FlowMint](https://flowmint.me): AI email marketing campaigns generated from any website URL
